sender.en: A resort, “accommodation” or travel page on Facebook or an online marketplace

how.en: A page advertises a beach resort, private pool or vacation package at a very low price, using photos and videos copied from real resorts. To “reserve the slot” you must pay a down payment or the full amount by e-wallet or bank transfer. When you arrive, the resort has no booking, or the page has disappeared. The PNP-ACG warns these cases rise before summer and holidays.

text.en: A page offers a resort or tour at a big discount.
It uses photos copied from a real resort.
Only a few slots are left, so you must reserve now.
You pay a down payment by e-wallet or to a personal account.
SUMMER PROMO! Private pool villa good for 15 pax, 50% OFF, P4,999 overnight only. Few dates left! Send 50% downpayment via GCash to lock your date.

en: resort booking page asked for downpayment then vanished
fake beach resort promo on facebook
reserved and sent money but the resort had no booking
private pool villa 50 percent off downpayment via gcash
Payment to a personal e-wallet or bank account.
A new page with few real reviews.
Book through the resort’s official website or a known booking platform, or call the resort on a number you found yourself.
If you paid, contact your bank or e-wallet straight away and report the page to the PNP-ACG.
